features: Eagle Eye Cloud Managed Video Recorder (CMVR): stores video locally and acts as a gateway to the Eagle Eye cloud
Video encrypted in transit and at rest
Supports ONVIF Profile S IP cameras
notes: Camera capacity is the datasheet's typical figure for 4 MP cameras.
Storage: 2025 datasheet gives 96 TB raw, 72 TB usable (RAID 5) and the hardware page gives 96 TB; 2023 datasheet gives 64 TB raw, 48 TB usable (RAID 5). The 2025 value is used.
2025 datasheet gives retention as 30 days for 100 cameras at 4 MP.
2023 datasheet gives LPR support as No; 2025 datasheet gives Yes. LPR support left out.
2023 datasheet gives network port speed as Dual Gigabit; 2025 datasheet gives Dual 2.5 Gigabit. Network port speed left out.
2023 datasheet gives video output as HDMI (1), VGA (1), DP (1); 2025 datasheet gives HDMI (2), DP (2). Video output left out.
2023 datasheet gives dimensions as 437 x 503 x 43 mm; 2025 datasheet gives 483 x 559 x 45 mm. Dimensions left out.
2023 datasheet gives maximum power consumption as 210 W; 2025 datasheet gives 500 W. Maximum power consumption left out.
